scope: Isolated mathematical controls; no full garment guarantee

contract.units: cm; inverse_mass uses one consistent arbitrary mass unit
contract.position_order: Same array order as vertices; IDs are explicit, not array indices
contract.thickness: Half-thickness per vertex; sum barycentrically interpolated sides at closest midsurface witnesses
contract.normal: From feature B towards feature A; independent of face winding
contract.projection: Frozen closest weights; alpha=0, lambda0=0; dlambda=max(0,-C/sum(w*c*c)); dx=w*c*n*dlambda
contract.parallel_tie: Midpoint of the overlap of projected finite segment intervals; invariant under endpoint reversal
contract.status: Isolated pair only; Converged requires rechecked clearance; IterationLimit can follow one valid frozen-witness projection
contract.invalid_start: Zero distance with movable points and no prior separating normal: InvalidInitialContact; all-pinned violation: InfeasibleBoundary
contract.degeneracy: Degenerate triangle candidate: ContactFailure here; documented lower-dimensional fallback may be separately tested
limits: No coupled-contact convergence, CCD, broad phase, friction or finite-radius variable-thickness surface guarantee
Same-strand eligibility is supplied deliberately; these controls do not choose a production exclusion policy
